COLS, ROWS = 30, 20

    pygame.K_UP: (0, -1), pygame.K_w: (0, -1),
    pygame.K_DOWN: (0, 1), pygame.K_s: (0, 1),
    pygame.K_LEFT: (-1, 0), pygame.K_a: (-1, 0),
    pygame.K_RIGHT: (1, 0), pygame.K_d: (1, 0),
}

        pygame.init()
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, WINDOW_H))
        pygame.display.set_caption("Snake")
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 26)

        self.diff_name = "Easy"

        self.direction = (1, 0)
        self.pending = None
        self.score = 0
        self.alive = True
        self.food = self.spawn_food()

    def spawn_food(self):
        while True:
            pos = (random.randrange(COLS), random.randrange(ROWS))
            if pos not in self.snake:
                return pos

    def handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
            if event.type != pygame.KEYDOWN:
                continue
            if event.key in DIRS:
                base = self.pending or self.direction
                nd = DIRS[event.key]
                if nd[0] + base[0] != 0 or nd[1] + base[1] != 0:
                    self.pending = nd
            elif event.key in DIFF_KEYS and not self.alive:
                return DIFF_KEYS[event.key]
            elif event.key == pygame.K_q and not self.alive:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
        return None

    def step(self):
        if self.pending:
            self.direction = self.pending
            self.pending = None
        hx, hy = self.snake[0]
        head = (hx + self.direction[0], hy + self.direction[1])
        eating = head == self.food
        body = self.snake if eating else self.snake[:-1]
        if not (0 <= head[0] < COLS and 0 <= head[1] < ROWS) or head in body:
            self.alive = False
            return
        self.snake.insert(0, head)
        if eating:
            self.score += 1
            self.food = self.spawn_food()
        else:
            self.snake.pop()

        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, color,
                         (x * CELL, INFO_H + y * CELL, CELL - 1, CELL - 1))

    def draw(self):
        self.screen.fill((15, 15, 15))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, (35, 35, 35), (0, INFO_H, WIDTH, HEIGHT))
        self.draw_cell(self.food, (220, 70, 70))
        for i, seg in enumerate(self.snake):
            self.draw_cell(seg, (90, 200, 120) if i else (60, 160, 100))
        info = self.font.render(
            "Score: {}    Difficulty: {}".format(self.score, self.diff_name),
            True, (235, 235, 235))

        if not self.alive:
            over = self.big_font.render(
                "Game Over  -  Score: {}".format(self.score), True, (255, 90, 90))
            prompt = self.font.render(
                "1/2/3 = new game (choose difficulty)   Q = quit",
                True, (200, 200, 200))
            self.screen.blit(over, over.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, INFO_H + HEIGHT // 2 - 15)))
            self.screen.blit(prompt, prompt.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, INFO_H + HEIGHT // 2 + 25)))

        while True:

            title = self.big_font.render("SNAKE", True, (90, 200, 120))

                self.screen.blit(text, text.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, y)))
                y += 36
            hint = self.font.render(
                "Arrows/WASD to move - eat red food - avoid walls and yourself",
                True, (170, 170, 170))
            self.screen.blit(hint, hint.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, y + 15)))
            pygame.display.flip()
            for event in pygame.event.get():
                if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                    pygame.quit()
                    sys.exit()
                if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key in DIFF_KEYS:
                    return DIFF_KEYS[event.key]

    def run(self):
        while True:
            key = self.menu()

    "Down": (0, 1), "s": (0, 1), "S": (0, 1),

    "Right": (1, 0), "d": (1, 0), "D": (1, 0),
}


class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("Snake")
        self.root.resizable(False, False)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.root, width=WIDTH, height=WINDOW_H,
                                bg="#0f0f0f", highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack()
        self.root.bind("<Key>", self.on_key)
        self.root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.quit)
        self.state = "menu"
        self.score = 0
        self.snake = []
        self.food = None
        self.direction = (1, 0)
        self.pending = None
        self.speed = 130
        self.diff_name = "Easy"
        self.draw_menu()

    def quit(self):
        self.root.destroy()

    def reset(self, speed, name):
        self.speed = speed
        self.diff_name = name
        self.snake = [(COLS // 2, ROWS // 2)]
        self.direction = (1, 0)
        self.pending = None
        self.score = 0
        self.food = self.spawn_food()

    def spawn_food(self):
        free = [(x, y) for x in range(COLS) for y in range(ROWS)
                if (x, y) not in self.snake]
        return random.choice(free) if free else None

    def on_key(self, event):
        key = event.keysym
        if key in ("q", "Q"):
            if self.state != "play":
                self.quit()
            return
        if self.state == "play":
            if key in DIRS:
                nd = DIRS[key]
                if nd[0] + self.direction[0] != 0 or nd[1] + self.direction[1] != 0:
                    self.pending = nd
        elif key in DIFFICULTIES:
            name, speed = DIFFICULTIES[key]
            self.reset(speed, name)
            self.state = "play"

    def step(self):
        if self.pending:
            self.direction = self.pending
            self.pending = None
        hx, hy = self.snake[0]
        head = (hx + self.direction[0], hy + self.direction[1])
        eating = head == self.food
        body = self.snake if eating else self.snake[:-1]
        if not (0 <= head[0] < COLS and 0 <= head[1] < ROWS) or head in body:
            self.state = "over"
            return
        self.snake.insert(0, head)
        if eating:
            self.score += 1
            self.food = self.spawn_food()
            if self.food is None:
                self.state = "over"
        else:
            self.snake.pop()

    def rect(self, pos):
        x, y = pos
        return (x * CELL + 1, INFO_H + y * CELL + 1, CELL - 2, CELL - 2)

    def draw(self):
        c = self.canvas
        c.delete("all")
        c.create_rectangle(0, INFO_H, WIDTH, WINDOW_H, fill="#232323", width=0)
        if self.food:
            c.create_rectangle(*self.rect(self.food), fill="#dc4646", width=0)
        for i, seg in enumerate(self.snake):
            c.create_rectangle(*self.rect(seg),
                               fill="#3ca064" if i == 0 else "#5ac878", width=0)
        c.create_text(10, INFO_H // 2, anchor="w", fill="#ebebeb",
                      text="Score: {}    Difficulty: {}".format(self.score, self.diff_name),
                      font=("Helvetica", 14))
        if self.state == "over":
            cx, cy = WIDTH // 2, INFO_H + HEIGHT // 2
            c.create_text(cx, cy - 20, fill="#ff5a5a", font=("Helvetica", 24, "bold"),
                          text="Game Over  -  Score: {}".format(self.score))
            c.create_text(cx, cy + 22, fill="#c8c8c8", font=("Helvetica", 12),
                          text="1/2/3 = new game (choose difficulty)   Q = quit")

    def draw_menu(self):
        c = self.canvas
        c.delete("all")
        c.create_text(WIDTH // 2, 70, text="SNAKE", fill="#5ac878",
                      font=("Helvetica", 32, "bold"))
        y = 150
        for key, (name, speed) in DIFFICULTIES.items():
            c.create_text(WIDTH // 2, y, fill="#ebebeb", font=("Helvetica", 14),
                          text="[{}]  {}  ({} ms per step)".format(key, name, speed))
            y += 36
        c.create_text(WIDTH // 2, y + 15, fill="#aaaaaa", font=("Helvetica", 12),
                      text="Arrows/WASD to move - eat red food - avoid walls and yourself")

    def loop(self):
        if self.state == "play":
            self.step()
            self.draw()
            self.root.after(self.speed, self.loop)
        else:
            self.root.after(100, self.loop)

    def run(self):
        self.loop()
        self.root.mainloop()

import random
import sys

import pygame

CELL = 20
COLS, ROWS = 30, 20
INFO_H = 40
WIDTH = COLS * CELL
HEIGHT = ROWS * CELL
WINDOW_H = HEIGHT + INFO_H

DIFFICULTIES = {"1": ("Easy", 8), "2": ("Medium", 13), "3": ("Hard", 20)}
DIFF_KEYS = {pygame.K_1: "1", pygame.K_2: "2", pygame.K_3: "3"}
DIRS = {
    pygame.K_UP: (0, -1), pygame.K_w: (0, -1),
    pygame.K_DOWN: (0, 1), pygame.K_s: (0, 1),
    pygame.K_LEFT: (-1, 0), pygame.K_a: (-1, 0),
    pygame.K_RIGHT: (1, 0), pygame.K_d: (1, 0),
}


class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        pygame.init()
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, WINDOW_H))
        pygame.display.set_caption("Snake")
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 26)
        self.big_font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 48)
        self.diff_name = "Easy"
        self.reset(8)

    def reset(self, speed):
        self.speed = speed
        self.snake = [(COLS // 2, ROWS // 2)]
        self.direction = (1, 0)
        self.pending = None
        self.score = 0
        self.alive = True
        self.food = self.spawn_food()

    def spawn_food(self):
        while True:
            pos = (random.randrange(COLS), random.randrange(ROWS))
            if pos not in self.snake:
                return pos

    def handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
            if event.type != pygame.KEYDOWN:
                continue
            if event.key in DIRS:
                # Only buffer one turn per step; while a turn is already
                # pending, ignore further keys so a second key pressed in
                # the same tick can never bypass the reversal guard.
                if self.pending is None:
                    nd = DIRS[event.key]
                    if nd != self.direction and (
                            nd[0] + self.direction[0] != 0
                            or nd[1] + self.direction[1] != 0):
                        self.pending = nd
            elif event.key in DIFF_KEYS and not self.alive:
                return DIFF_KEYS[event.key]
            elif event.key == pygame.K_q and not self.alive:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
        return None

    def step(self):
        if self.pending:
            self.direction = self.pending
            self.pending = None
        hx, hy = self.snake[0]
        head = (hx + self.direction[0], hy + self.direction[1])
        eating = head == self.food
        body = self.snake if eating else self.snake[:-1]
        if not (0 <= head[0] < COLS and 0 <= head[1] < ROWS) or head in body:
            self.alive = False
            return
        self.snake.insert(0, head)
        if eating:
            self.score += 1
            self.food = self.spawn_food()
        else:
            self.snake.pop()

    def draw_cell(self, pos, color):
        x, y = pos
        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, color,
                         (x * CELL, INFO_H + y * CELL, CELL - 1, CELL - 1))

    def draw(self):
        self.screen.fill((15, 15, 15))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, (35, 35, 35), (0, INFO_H, WIDTH, HEIGHT))
        self.draw_cell(self.food, (220, 70, 70))
        for i, seg in enumerate(self.snake):
            self.draw_cell(seg, (90, 200, 120) if i else (60, 160, 100))
        info = self.font.render(
            "Score: {}    Difficulty: {}".format(self.score, self.diff_name),
            True, (235, 235, 235))
        self.screen.blit(info, (10, 9))
        if not self.alive:
            over = self.big_font.render(
                "Game Over  -  Score: {}".format(self.score), True, (255, 90, 90))
            prompt = self.font.render(
                "1/2/3 = new game (choose difficulty)   Q = quit",
                True, (200, 200, 200))
            self.screen.blit(over, over.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, INFO_H + HEIGHT // 2 - 15)))
            self.screen.blit(prompt, prompt.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, INFO_H + HEIGHT // 2 + 25)))
        pygame.display.flip()

    def menu(self):
        while True:
            self.screen.fill((15, 15, 15))
            title = self.big_font.render("SNAKE", True, (90, 200, 120))
            self.screen.blit(title, title.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, 70)))
            y = 150
            for key, (name, speed) in DIFFICULTIES.items():
                text = self.font.render(
                    "[{}]  {}  (speed {})".format(key, name, speed),
                    True, (235, 235, 235))
                self.screen.blit(text, text.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, y)))
                y += 36
            hint = self.font.render(
                "Arrows/WASD to move - eat red food - avoid walls and yourself",
                True, (170, 170, 170))
            self.screen.blit(hint, hint.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, y + 15)))
            pygame.display.flip()
            for event in pygame.event.get():
                if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                    pygame.quit()
                    sys.exit()
                if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key in DIFF_KEYS:
                    return DIFF_KEYS[event.key]

    def run(self):
        while True:
            key = self.menu()
            self.diff_name, speed = DIFFICULTIES[key][0], DIFFICULTIES[key][1]
            self.reset(speed)
            while True:
                choice = self.handle_events()
                if choice:
                    break
                if self.alive:
                    self.step()
                self.draw()
                self.clock.tick(self.speed if self.alive else 15)
